risks.title: Non-compliance with financial covenants
risks.score_rationale: The risk is cited in connection with an urgent modification of the Credit Agreement to avoid default. The language indicates anticipated non-compliance with leverage ratios. Capital category heavily weighted.

risks.title: Cyberattack or system breach
risks.score_rationale: Explicit mention in risk factors (No. 16) and dedicated governance at the CISO level. Board reporting structure reinforces importance. Technical language but no mention of recent incident.

risks.title: Impact of trade tensions and tariffs
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in management's analysis with reference to concrete measures (US tariffs, EU steel quotas). Active risk in 2025, linked to industrially exposed segments.

risks.title: Clean Earth separation and post-merger integration
risks.score_rationale: Major transaction announced ($3B+) with Veolia. High risk of failure or operational disruption. Mentioned in forward-looking risks with language of uncertainty ('could differ materially').

risks.title: Customer concentration and long-term contracts
risks.score_rationale: Identified as key risk (No. 8) with mention of complex fixed-price contracts. Potential impact on margin and flexibility. Context stable but structural.

risks.title: Environmental regulatory non-compliance
risks.score_rationale: Risk No. 4 in forward-looking factors, directly linked to core business (waste management). Possible sanctions, operational shutdown. Strong language ('inability to comply').

risks.title: Loss of key personnel or talent retention challenges
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in risks (No. 14) related to talent management. Less intense than other risks, but reinforced by ongoing restructuring.

ai_positioning.summary: NVRI does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its report.
